notes:
BFE is now Banners File Explorer — a big update.

New look: Aurora Glass (frosted glass, calm neutral colours, smooth animations) with palettes in Settings, and the previous design kept as "Classic" (Settings → Look). New app icon (squircle) with more icons to choose from in Settings → App icon, and BFE's own folder and file icons throughout.

Home screen: storage, Downloads, Images, Audio, Videos, Documents, Apps (backup / share / clone), New files, Cloud, Remote and Access from network — plus your own App storage tiles (tap + to add another app's storage).

Built-in players: a photo viewer (swipe, zoom, slideshow) and a VLC-powered video and music player that plays almost any format, with picture, effects, equalizer and subtitle controls, gestures, resume and picture-in-picture. Also a built-in HTML viewer.

Archives: browse inside archives like folders; one-tap "Extract to ./<Archive name>/" from any app's Open with list, running in the background with Pause / Cancel and a queue in the notification; new formats lzip, lzop, LZ4, ECM, ALZ, EGG, ACE, Amiga LZX and OTA payload.bin.

Cloud & network: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, MEGA, S3, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV and more (engine downloads on first use), and a Wi-Fi file server (web + FTP) so other devices can reach your files.

Also: video thumbnails, folders A→Z then newest files first, dates with times, outlined menus, lists refresh in place when you come back, and many fixes.

Note: if the home-screen shortcut disappears after updating, add Banners File Explorer again from the app drawer (the launcher icon changed).
